parameters.content:
# HA - Sending Immediate Escalation Alert to a Human Agent

## Purpose
The immediate hand-off step when the main chatbot decides a customer email needs a human. It tells the customer their case has been forwarded, tags the Gmail thread for human visibility, and pings the on-call agent on Telegram with the full case context so they can take over without digging through sheets.

## How it works
- Receives the full email context (thread/message IDs, subject, sender, last message, conversation history, channel, timestamps) from the calling workflow
- Labels the Gmail thread so human agents can filter their inbox for escalated cases
- Sends an automated HTML confirmation reply to the customer setting the 1-hour response expectation
- Marks the customer's original message as read so it does not re-trigger the main chatbot
- Pushes a formatted Telegram alert to the on-call human agent with sender info, the latest message, a deep link back to the Gmail thread, and a link to the Interaction_Logs sheet filtered by thread

## Triggered by
Execute Workflow trigger  invoked as a sub-workflow by the Main AI Customer Support Chatbot Workflow whenever it detects a case that needs human handling.

## Called by
- Main AI Customer Support Chatbot Workflow

## Reads/writes
- Writes to Gmail (applies escalation label, sends confirmation reply, marks message read)
- Sends a Telegram message to the configured human-agent chat
- Includes a link to Google Sheets `Customer_Support_Data`  `Interaction_Logs` in the Telegram alert (read-only reference)
